name: tool-boundary-out-of-scope
body: SCOPE CORRECTION [with user]: the `opencode-suite/` tree — the `apg_*` tools used to read the graph — is apg 0.14.1's fixed tooling and is NOT a subject of this change-set. The curated tools' path handling (re-basing the stored repo-relative identity to an absolute path at their boundary against the project `directory`) is therefore out of scope; apg 0.14.1 is the only version that exists throughout this spec/plan/implementation, so there is no tool change to specify. Only the graph side is the change: identities repo-relative end to end. On that basis `requirements.requirement.absolute-paths-at-tool-boundary` was removed, together with the domain entity `domain.entity.tool-path-resolution`, the solution component `solution.component.tool-path-resolution`, and the container `solution.container.opencode-suite`. The surviving design decision is recorded in `requirements.note.relative-in-graph-absolute-at-tools`; the graph-side requirement remains `requirements.requirement.portable-graph-identity`.
